parameters.name: Accessibility
parameters.description:
The visibility of the Tensorboard instance. Valid values:
- PUBLIC: visible to all members in the workspace.
- PRIVATE: visible only to you and administrators in the workspace.

parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: The display name of the Tensorboard instance.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query range. Tensorboard instances are filtered by their creation time in UTC. If this parameter is left empty, the default value is the current time.

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The DLC job ID used to filter Tensorboard instances. Call [ListJobs](~~459676~~) to obtain the job ID.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:
- desc: descending order.
- asc: ascending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for paging. The value starts from 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of Tensorboard instances to return on each page for paging.

parameters.name: PaymentType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the Tensorboard instance. Valid values:
- Free: a Tensorboard instance that uses free resources.
- Postpaid: a Tensorboard instance that uses pay-as-you-go resources.

parameters.name: QuotaId
parameters.description:
The resource quota ID.
> - Currently, only whitelisted users can use resource quota resources to create Tensorboard instances. To use this feature, contact us.
> - This parameter takes effect only when the Tensorboard instance uses resource quota resources.

parameters.name: ShowOwn
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return only Tensorboard instances created by the current user.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The field by which the results are sorted. Valid values:
- DisplayName: the job name.
- GmtCreateTime: the job creation time.

parameters.name: SourceId
parameters.description: The data source ID. Call [ListJobs](~~459676~~) to obtain the job ID.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description: The data source type. Currently, only DLC training jobs are supported, which means the value is job.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query range. Tensorboard instances are filtered by their creation time in UTC. If this parameter is left empty, the default value is 7 days before the current time.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The Tensorboard status. Valid values:
- Creating: being created.
- Running: running.
- Stopped: stopped.
- Succeeded: succeeded.
- Failed: failed.

parameters.name: TensorboardId
parameters.description: The Tensorboard ID used to filter the Tensorboard list.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: The user ID.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: The username.

parameters.name: Verbose
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to display details.
- true: Display details.
- false: Do not display details.

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace ID. Tensorboard instances are filtered by workspace ID. <props="china">Call [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) to obtain the workspace ID.</props>.
